summary: Iteration 21 — Full E2E testing of Projects/Events, Event Invitations, and Contact Lists modules for Marsol B2B networking ERP. Backend: 25/25 tests passed (project_events CRUD, event_invitations CRUD + status transitions + convert-to-lead, contact_lists CRUD + contacts + Excel import + convert-to-lead, cascade delete, guest_count/attended_count aggregation, RBAC for sales/accountant, regression for old Obligations /api/invitations and /api/obligations/dashboard). Frontend: sidebar menus (menu-sales-contact-lists, menu-sales-invitations) render under Satış group, all three pages (contact-lists-page, invitations-page, projects-page) load, Add modals open with correct field structure, RBAC hides write buttons for Mühasib (accountant) on both /sales/contact-lists and /projects.

issues: On fresh page load a couple of background /api calls return 401 before token is attached (AxiosError logged). Non-blocking, but UI should gate API calls behind token presence or silently retry after auth context resolves.

passed_tests: POST /api/auth/login — admin/sales/accountant all succeed
GET /api/project-events — returns list with guest_count and attended_count fields
POST /api/project-events — admin creates event, initial guest_count=0/attended_count=0
PUT /api/project-events/{id} — status update persists (verified via GET)
DELETE /api/project-events/{id} — cascade deletes related event_invitations (verified event_id filter returns [])
GET /api/event-invitations?event_id=X — filter works
POST /api/event-invitations — creates guest with default status 'Dəvət edilib'
PUT /api/event-invitations/{id} — status transitions Gələcəm → Gəlməyəcəm → İştirak etdi all work
POST /api/event-invitations/{id}/convert-to-lead — creates sales_lead with SB-XXX code and writes converted_to_lead flag back
guest_count = count of event_invitations matching event_id; attended_count = status 'İştirak etdi' — verified after 3 guests + 1 attended
GET /api/contact-lists — returns lists with contact_count aggregate
POST /api/contact-lists — creates list with initial contact_count=0
POST /api/contact-lists/{id}/contacts — adds contact; contact_count increments
POST /api/contact-lists/{id}/import — accepts JSON {contacts:[{Ad,Soyad,Şirkət,...}]} AZ-column mapping and English keys; bulk inserts
POST /api/contact-lists/{id}/import with empty contacts → 400
POST /api/contacts/{id}/convert-to-lead — creates lead with SB-XXX code
RBAC: Satış meneceri CAN POST event-invitations and contact-lists
RBAC: Mühasib is 401/403 on POST /api/event-invitations and /api/contact-lists
Regression: GET /api/obligations/dashboard still works (Obligations module untouched)
Regression: GET /api/invitations (old Obligations-based endpoint) still works and is separate from /api/event-invitations
Frontend: Sidebar shows 'Satış > Siyahılar' (menu-sales-contact-lists) and 'Satış > Dəvətlər' (menu-sales-invitations) for admin
Frontend: /sales/contact-lists renders [data-testid=contact-lists-page], 'Yeni Siyahı' modal opens with Başlıq + Açıqlama fields

Frontend: /sales/invitations renders [data-testid=invitations-page], Excel button + 'Qonaq əlavə et' button visible, modal contains Tədbir Select + Qonaq adı + Şirkət + Vəzifə + Telefon + Email + Qeyd
Frontend: /projects renders [data-testid=projects-page], 'Yeni Layihə' (add-event-btn) creates modal opens

Frontend RBAC: Mühasib sidebar does NOT show Satış or Layihələr groups at all (module-level hide); when navigated directly to /sales/contact-lists the 'Yeni Siyahı' button is hidden; on /projects the add-event-btn is hidden
critical_code_review_comments: lead_code generation uses db.sales_leads.count_documents({}) which is not concurrency-safe and will collide under parallel conversion. Consider an atomic counter (findOneAndUpdate on a counters doc) or UUID-based code.

convert_contact_to_lead does NOT write converted=True/lead_id back to the contact (unlike convert_event_invitation_to_lead which does). Inconsistency — contacts can be converted multiple times and produce duplicate leads.

/api/contact-lists/{list_id}/import silently ignores list_id validation: non-existent list still returns 200 with inserted rows that become orphan contacts. Add a pre-check that the list exists (404) before insert.
update_project_event and update_event_invitation do not return 404 when id doesn't exist — update_one matchedCount=0 still returns the (None) doc. Should raise HTTPException on missing.
server.py is 2800+ lines — consider splitting into routers (projects.py, invitations.py, contact_lists.py) for maintainability (triggers the >700-line rule in review guidelines).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testid selectors present, pages load, modals open, RBAC hides write controls correctly)

seed_data_creation: All TEST_-prefixed data (events, invitations, contact lists, contacts, leads) cleaned up in the final test_z_cleanup_created_data step. A couple of TEST_ leads may persist if DELETE /api/sales-leads/{id} endpoint is not implemented — main agent can verify.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 21 verified the new B2B networking stack end-to-end. Key endpoints live under /api/project-events (replaces old /api/projects where applicable), /api/event-invitations (NEW — separate from legacy /api/invitations which is kept for Obligations module), and /api/contact-lists. Cascade: deleting a project-event also deletes its event_invitations. Aggregation: GET /api/project-events enriches each doc with guest_count+attended_count on the fly. Convert flows: invitation→lead adds {converted_to_lead:true, lead_id} back to invitation; contact→lead does NOT (potential bug). RBAC permission key is 'sales' for both contact_lists and event_invitations; 'projects' for project_events. All frontend pages use data-testid contact-lists-page / invitations-page / projects-page / add-event-btn and sidebar menu-sales-contact-lists / menu-sales-invitations.
